observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection over canonical Store session events

outcome.interpretation: The canonical projection relates two merge denials to the selected session objective and authority subsystem. The denial records contain no blocker claim identities, so current liveness, denial-time state, and cause cannot be reconstructed.
outcome.analysis_limit: This is a truncated window from one session. It does not establish cross-session recurrence, that either denial was unnecessary, or that a stale claim caused either denial.

related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket

pressure_hypothesis.title: Merge denial events lack blocker identities for current claim-state diagnosis
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment authority denial, workspace claims, and session projections
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An authenticated selected session window contains two merge denials classified as overlapping-claim. Neither event records blocker claim identity, and the projection therefore returns no-recorded-claim-identities without inferring denial-time liveness or cause.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve exact blocker claim identities in future structured denial evidence and expose their current liveness separately, so agents can distinguish active conflicts from recoverable, released, or expired claims without rewriting historical evidence.
not_measured: whether either denial was incorrect or avoidable
which claim or checkout caused either denial
whether a later claim recovery changes merge outcomes
cause or appropriateness of either historical denial
agent or model identity and configuration
effectiveness of subsequent claim or authority changes
